item.title: Dysphoric Flesh
item.description: Currently seeking feedback from all, but esp. trans users
item.content:encoded:
CW/TW: Discussion of trans trauma, dysphoria, and suicide, by a trans individual.

http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/oystershell Look under the "Dysphoric Flesh" tab.

This is a story about what truly horrifies me most. In case it's not clear, I'm trans myself.

While anyone and everyone's thoughts and critiques are welcome, I am especially keen on receiving feedback from other trans and non-binary folks.

Thanks in advance.

item.title: The Friendly Shadow
item.description: Clarence's Shadow is sapient, alive, and his best friend.
item.content:encoded:
Aloha guys! Here's my first attempt at an SCP. It's filled with 1,551 words. I know it definitely needs work, but because I'm basically blind, I'm sure whoever stumbles upon this can easily correct my mistakes faster.
So, have at it: http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/drcope

Greenlights in the replies.

Brief Intro: It's a living shadow attached to a human (Clarence).

I believe I must certainly work on the Interviews. Other than that, I'm not observant or educated enough to see what else needs corrected. To anyone about to Crit this, thanks.

item.title: The Abyss is Safe, Looking For Co-Authors
item.description: A cave at the bottom of the sea, and the crew that fell apart to it.
item.content:encoded:
First greenlit SCP article draft. A cave at the bottom of the sea, and the crew that fell apart to it. That being said I need some help

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Would appreciate look overs, critiques, and anything to help make it interesting. If you like it enough though, let me know.

Word count: Roughly 3600

Greenlight: http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13886686/the-abyss-is-safe-seeking-crits-and-greenlight

Draft: http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/the-safe-deep-dark-wip
